statements.statement: The patient has a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation (I48.91)
The palpitations have not been adequately characterized by standard short-term monitoring
A 30-day continuous ambulatory ECG monitoring study is indicated
CPT code 93247 (long-term continuous ECG monitoring) was billed
The service was denied under reason code CO-22
The denial was based on coordination of benefits protocols indicating another payer holds primary responsibility
